title: BEFORE YOU
*HIRE AN SEO*
COMPANY
slides.sub: Five red flags I'd walk away from.

title: THE WRONG ONE
*COSTS A YEAR*
slides.body: Then it leaves you a mess to clean up.

title: A RANKING
*GUARANTEE*
slides.body: Google's own guide says no one can guarantee a #1 ranking. If they promise it, find someone else.

title: A "SPECIAL
*RELATIONSHIP"*
WITH GOOGLE
slides.body: Google warns about this pitch too. Nobody gets a back door.

title: QUICK-WIN
*SHORTCUTS*
slides.body: Fake reviews. Junk links. Copy-paste suburb pages. Works for a month, then Google catches up.

title: LOCKED IN FOR
*12 MONTHS*
slides.body: If the work is good, you'll stay anyway. If it's not working, you should be free to stop.

title: THEY CAN'T RANK
*THEMSELVES*
slides.body: Search "SEO" plus their suburb. If they don't show up in their own backyard, ask why.

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Google profile for free.
